lessons_used: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though they underestimated top-performing wins in adoption redesigns and home wait_info.
Adding new screens to the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently degraded performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful, while home redesigns (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Updating home wait_info frequently yielded wins (5 wins out of 17 tests), though many tests produced no clear effect.
Finish copy (5 tests), finish layout (3 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and choose_path layout (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or conflicting for change types with only one test or mixed outcomes, such as finish redesigns and sign-in reordering.

candidates.title: Story-Scroll Path Stage Experience
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen into a fluid story-scroll visual layout connecting journey options directly with interactive path preview cards.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a 20.5% dropoff rate and a high mean completion time of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select the path that matches how you want to interact with your desktop pet daily.

guard.reason: Redesigning the choose_path screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has a 20.5% dropoff; choose_path redesigns historically average a +2.2% lift across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Custom Photo Multi-Angle Creator Flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds photo upload into a multi-angle photo picker flow with live visual preview feedback before submission.
candidates.why: Support receives tickets about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption stage takes median 89s / mean 1017s.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Upload clear photos from multiple angles for optimal 3D pet generation.

guard.reason: Redesigning photo upload into a multi-angle creator flow inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Both support emails and funnel time point to custom photo issues, but adding new flows/screens consistently degrades conversion.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Pick Friend Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen using a stage layout featuring companion selection cards and trait badges.
candidates.why: Adoption stage redesigns have historically generated high conversion gains and streamline selection.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select your starter companion to personalize its visual traits and behavior.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns are top performers with an average +5.7% lift across 5 tests.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence
candidates.change: Reorders sign_in to occur right after adoption_certificate and before waiting screen generation.
candidates.why: Sign-in drops 24.9% of users early; moving sign-in after character adoption capitalizes on user commitment while safeguarding account sync.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after adoption_certificate is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign_in drops 24.9% of users, but reordering steps has a negative historical average (-1.1% across 6 tests).

candidates.title: Live Render Time Remaining Tracker
candidates.change: Adds an explicit time estimate countdown timer and progress indicator on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a very long mean duration of 2336s, and updating wait_info on home frequently yields conversion wins.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Arriving Soon

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info updates frequently yield wins (5 out of 17 tests, +1.2% avg) and are simple configuration changes.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Ready Desktop Notification

candidates.why: Users face median 201s waiting times; notification callouts allow users to safely switch windows while waiting.

waiting.body: Feel free to minimize this window. You will get a notification as soon as your pet launches on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding desktop notifications to the waiting screen is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Notification changes across stages tend to underperform, and native desktop notification triggers require full release work.

candidates.title: Account Pet Storage Persistence Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign_in screen headline and body copy to explicitly clarify that account creation saves pets from being reset or lost.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.

guard.reason: Updating copy on the sign_in screen is allowed and complies with fair design rules.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overly optimistic, but underestimated major wins in adoption redesigns and home wait_info updates.
Adding new screens to the adoption stage (2 tests) or finish stage (2 tests) consistently degraded performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (3 wins out of 6 tests) and choose_path stage (2 wins out of 5 tests) proved helpful.
Updating home wait_info frequently yielded wins (5 wins out of 18 tests), though most tests produced no clear effect.
Finish copy (5 tests), finish layout (4 tests), choose_path hints (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or conflicting for change types with mixed outcomes or single tests, such as sign-in reordering, adoption hints, and adoption copy.
